set_all_non_lazy_fields: create a protobuf TestAllTypes message and set every non-lazy field to a unique test value
set_all_fields: create a protobuf TestAllTypes message and set every field including lazy fields to unique values
set_all_extensions: create a protobuf TestAllExtensions message and set every extension field to a unique test value
expect_all_fields_set: test a protobuf message by asserting all optional, repeated, and default fields have expected values
golden_file: find and open a golden test data file from the protobuf source tree for binary comparison
